description: A no-break space after the closing marker does not stop it from ending the heredoc
notes: The spec says the marker must appear on a line of its own and doesn't say whether whitespace may follow it on that line. hashicorp/hcl compares each candidate line with its leading and trailing Unicode whitespace removed by bytes.TrimSpace, for both heredoc forms (the heredocLiteralEOL action in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl), and bytes.TrimSpace also removes U+00A0 NO-BREAK SPACE.
